interview_answers.order: kitty first: FRI-613 then FRI-624 (Unicode placeholders + a=q answer) (user, 2026-11-26)
interview_answers.query: the a=q answer stays off in FRI-613 so Claude Code never sees half kitty; walk uses chafa -f kitty (user, 2026-11-26)
interview_answers.security: protection in Nergal, not a fork; after iprev r1 the byte filter became Nergal owning the termwiz parser and gating typed kitty actions before perform_actions
interview_answers.memory_invariant: PTY output can never grow Nergal memory without bound through kitty: per-terminal lifetime caps on forwarded bytes and cells instead of tracking wezterm memory (user, 2026-11-26, convergence rule after iprev r1+r2)
interview_answers.caps: low lifetime caps with a visible notice: 256 MiB, 131072 cells, 1024 placements, 4096 transmissions, 4096 deletes; deletes pass after the other caps (user, 2026-11-26, after iprev r4)
interview_answers.placement_ids: Strip placement ids in the gate (user, 2026-11-26): wezterm set_cell re-attaches placement-id images onto a cloned cell, doubling them per overlapping placement; the gate forwards placements and ByImageId deletes with placement_id None, so one image id shows in one place at a time.
interview_answers.stack_depth: Stack depth cap of 8 images per cell, checked in the session before each placement; exceeding it drops the placement and pauses kitty with the notice (user, 2026-11-26: recommended option, and do not keep hunting extreme edge cases).
